Mar: Sanjay realizes Farah's 'black box' is a company risk, not just Meera's concern. Apr: Sanjay suggests Farah mentor Anil directly instead of documenting — creative solution.

trigger_definitions.VAGUE_FEEDBACK: Manager gives evaluative statements without naming specific situation, behavior, or impact
trigger_definitions.MANAGER_DOMINATING: Manager speaks 70%+ of the conversation, doesn't create space for the employee
trigger_definitions.NO_ACTION_ITEMS: Meeting segment or full meeting ends without clear commitments (who/what/when)
trigger_definitions.CLOSED_QUESTIONS_ONLY: Manager asks only yes/no or leading questions, no open exploratory questions
trigger_definitions.JUMPING_TO_SOLUTIONS: Employee describes problem, manager immediately gives the answer without exploring
trigger_definitions.NO_FOLLOW_UP: No reference to previous meeting commitments or action items
trigger_definitions.MISSED_GOAL_REFERENCE: Relevant OKR exists but neither person brings it up when it's clearly relevant
trigger_definitions.ALL_CRITICISM_NO_RECOGNITION: All manager feedback in the segment is negative with zero acknowledgment of positives

manager.COACHING_HABIT: Michael Bungay Stanier's 7 questions — used when JUMPING_TO_SOLUTIONS or CLOSED_QUESTIONS_ONLY fires
manager.RADICAL_CANDOR: Care Personally + Challenge Directly — used when ALL_CRITICISM_NO_RECOGNITION fires or emotional dismissal detected

employee.GROW: Goal-Reality-Options-Way Forward — used when employee isn't self-advocating
employee.DESC: Describe-Express-Specify-Consequences — used when employee is passive or disengaged
